expected_response.note: No permitted bounded declarative edit has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent on the supplied evidence; the supported pair-kernel and shape contrasts are not expressible by the executing pointcloud scalar.

failure_modes: Editing pointcloud_delta_A would change the curvature of the executing pointcloud scalar, which has no pair-kernel or moment term, so it cannot express the supported pair_kernel/shape contrasts and risks unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates without a defensible expected affinity advantage.

A temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit would condition regional attention on contrast curves whose last-node empirical and fitted signs frequently disagree and whose sign conflicts exceed the audit threshold, so the time-conditioned rule is not distinguishable from the constant rule on this evidence.

Changing teacher_neighbors treats a neighbor count as a distance bandwidth; the fixed temperatures and supplied teacher provenance must be preserved, and the static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts rather than actual final structures.

Reading survival enrichment or turnover residual as final affinity benefit would misstate recorded joint-head credit and an accounting diagnostic that includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest and most reproducible signed contrasts are on pair-distance shell densities (pair_kernel_1.5-5.0 positive, pair_kernel_7.0 negative) and on reduced shape_yy/shape_xx anisotropy, but the executing pointcloud scalar R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau) with q the Hungarian mean squared endpoint distance contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit). No registered bounded declarative edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can express those contrasts, so the supported evidence does not provide a defensible expected advantage for any permitted edit over the incumbent. The temporal alternatives are also unsupported: the supplied continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear interpolants over [0.0,0.49] with no accepted polynomial fit, many sign changes and strong sign conflicts, and the curve-fidelity audit selected only 24 curves with last-node empirical and fitted signs frequently disagreeing, so a time-conditioned regional attention or teacher-blend rule cannot be distinguished from the constant rule. Teacher-neighbor count is a count, not a distance bandwidth, and the fixed temperatures (mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0) are immutable. Joint-motion and turnover diagnostics are accounting/descriptive evidence, not operative reward terms, and decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable, so survival credit cannot be read as final affinity benefit. Under the affinity-first objective, retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice; no temperature edit is proposed.
